mavzu: Unit 6: Team building. Lesson 1.B. Teenage problems

savollar.savol: Grammatika qoidasiga ko'ra, "such" so'zidan keyin odatda qanday so'z turkumi keladi?
Grammatika qoidasiga ko'ra, "so" so'zi odatda qaysi so'z turkumi bilan birga ishlatiladi?
Darslikdagi grammatik qoidaga ko'ra, otlardan oldin va sifatlardan keyin keladigan so'z qaysi?
Matnda bullying nechta asosiy turga bo'lingan?
"Bully for you" kompyuter o'yinida o'yinchi qanday rolni o'ynaydi?
O'yin ishlab chiqaruvchilari uni taqiqlash haqidagi chaqiriqlarga qanday javob berishdi?
Matnga ko'ra, o'yinni taqiqlashni kim talab qilgan?
"Personally" so'zi fikr bildirishda qanday ma'noni anglatadi?
"Obviously" so'zi qanday ma'noni anglatadi?
Birinchi do'stlik iqtibosida "Friendship is one mind in ___ bodies" jumlasida qaysi son ishlatiladi?
"He is ______ lazy to get involved in extracurricular activities" gapini to'ldiring.
"This computer is _____ slow to do the calculation" gapini to'ldiring.
"There are _____ many rules of being a good friend" gapini to'ldiring.
"It is not ________ for you to have the right attitude" gapini to'ldiring.
"You are ________ a good friend" gapini to'ldiring.
Matnga ko'ra, o'yin ishlab chiqaruvchilari o'yindagi zo'ravonlikni qanday oqlashadi?
variantlar: Zo'ravonlik bullylarga qaratilgan va qurbonlarni himoya qiladi

savollar.savol: Anti-bullying xayriya tashkilotlari o'yin haqida qanday xavotir bildirishgan?
variantlar: O'yin odamlarni bullylarga zo'ravonlik bilan javob berishga undashi mumkin

savollar.savol: Matndagi ro'yxatga ko'ra, "Punching" (musht tushirish) harakati qaysi bullying turiga eng mos keladi?
Matndagi ro'yxatga ko'ra, "Teasing" (masxara qilish) harakati qaysi bullying turiga eng mos keladi?
Matndagi ro'yxatga ko'ra, "Spreading rumors/gossiping" (mish-mish tarqatish) qaysi bullying turiga misol bo'ladi?
"The film was very sad. Everyone cried." jumlalarini "so" yordamida to'g'ri birlashtiring.
variantlar: The film was so sad that everyone cried.
The film was too sad everyone cried.
The film was enough sad that everyone cried.
The film was such sad that everyone cried.

savollar.savol: "It was a very good meal. We ate far too much." jumlalarini "such" yordamida to'g'ri birlashtiring.
variantlar: It was so good meal that we ate far too much.
It was such good meal we ate too much.
It was such a good meal that we ate far too much.
It was too good meal that we ate far too much.

savollar.savol: "He can't walk far. He's old." jumlalarini "too" yordamida to'g'ri birlashtiring.
variantlar: He's too old to walk far.
He's so old that he can't walk far.
He's old enough to walk far.

savollar.savol: "My friend was kind. He paid for the meal." jumlalarini "enough" yordamida to'g'ri birlashtiring.
variantlar: My friend was enough kind to pay for the meal.
My friend was so kind to pay for the meal.
My friend was too kind to pay for the meal.
My friend was kind enough to pay for the meal.

savollar.savol: "How much money have we got? Can we pay for the tickets?" jumlalarini "enough" yordamida to'g'ri birlashtiring.
variantlar: We have so much money to pay for tickets.
We have too much money for the tickets.
Have we got money enough to pay for the tickets?
Have we got enough money to pay for the tickets?

savollar.savol: Matnga ko'ra, tadqiqot natijalarida o'qituvchilar bullying holatlarining qanchasini payqashadi?
Agar maktabda 50 ta bullying holati sodir bo'lsa va o'qituvchilar har 25 ta holatdan bittasini payqasa, taxminan nechta holat payqalmay qoladi?
Matndagi TRUE/FALSE mashqiga ko'ra, britaniyalik siyosatchi o'yin haqida qanday pozitsiyada bo'lgan?
Ishlab chiqaruvchilarning fikricha o'yin orqali o'quvchilar nimani o'rganadi va bu tanqidchilarning fikriga qanday zid keladi?
variantlar: O'rganish — matematik hisob-kitob; tanqidchilar rozi emas
O'rganish — yangi o'yin qoidalari; tanqidchilar rozi
Matnda bu haqida hech narsa aytilmagan
O'rganish — bullylarga qarshi turish; tanqidchilar esa bu zo'ravonlikni rag'batlantiradi deb hisoblaydi

savollar.savol: Uchinchi do'stlik iqtibosiga ko'ra ("A real friend is one who walks in when the rest of the world walks out"), bu fikr qanday ma'noni anglatadi?
variantlar: Haqiqiy do'st faqat yaxshi kunlarda yoningda bo'ladi
Haqiqiy do'st doim g'oyib bo'lib turadi
Haqiqiy do'st hamma sendan voz kechganda ham yoningda qoladi
